biology: Specimens collected from Chinese parasol tree (Firmiana simplex).
soldier: Head of the soldier brown with a reddish tinge, strongly shining, labrum yellowish brown, antennae concolorous with the head, pronotum also yellowish brown. Pilosity of the head sparse, the middle region of the pronotum with about 30 setae. Head capsule nearly rectangular, slightly narrowed anteriorly, both broad and thick, the fontanelle rather projecting. Antennae 13–14 segments, the first and third nearly equal, the third about twice the second. Eye spots circular and not projecting. Labrum semicircular. Mandibles sabre-shaped and stout, the apex slightly curved, the outer margin smooth. Lacinia of the maxilla with about ten marginal hairs. Pronotum kidney-shaped, the anterior margin concave in a broad V, the lateral margins steeply inclined posteriorly, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave, the median longitudinal line distinct. Hind leg 2.5 times as long as the femur width.
